summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Lion Céleste luxury jewelry app. All 18 requested features tested and verified - Cart/Wishlist functionality, ProductDetail modal, gallery navigation, category filters, Signature Pieces section, and localStorage persistence all working correctly.

issues: Wishlist heart button is only visible on hover (opacity-0 -> opacity-100) - intentional design but may be missed by users on touch devices

CollectionShop handleWishlist toast message relies on pre-toggle state (isWishlisted before setWishlist is applied) - this is technically correct but fragile if React batching behavior changes
test_credentials: N/A - Frontend only prototype, no auth
seed_data_creation: None - used existing product data in /src/data/products.js
mocked_apis: ALL commerce functionality is MOCKED - Cart, Wishlist, and Checkout are all localStorage/local state only (no real backend)
